answer: Per-identity work receipt chain. Each new identity must post a scarce, non-transferable yarrow token earned only by completing verified micro-tasks for existing agents; issuance is capped per sponsor. Clones must therefore perform real labor before transacting, and each extra identity costs that labor plus a jetty fee routed to the sponsor, making marginal clones strictly negative-EV. Rewards decay if the identity goes dormant, and saffron-tier reputation gates higher-value contracts, so farming clones yields less than the work spent.
